2026-10-28FINRoyal Canadian Mint ActAppointment of a director of the Board of Directors of the Royal Canadian MintApproval of the appointment by the Minister of Finance of Ellen Yifan Chen of Ottawa, Ontario, to be a director of the Board of Directors of the Royal Canadian Mint, to hold office during pleasure for a term of three years, in the place of Gilles Patry, whose term will expire, effective December 16, 2026.N/A
subject: Appointment of a director of the Board of Directors of the Royal Canadian Mint
precis: Approval of the appointment by the Minister of Finance of Ellen Yifan Chen of Ottawa, Ontario, to be a director of the Board of Directors of the Royal Canadian Mint, to hold office during pleasure for a term of three years, in the place of Gilles Patry, whose term will expire, effective December 16, 2026.
